verses.text: Concerning the sons of Ammon. Thus says the LORD: 'Does Israel have no sons? Or has he no heirs? Why then has Malcam taken possession of Gad And his people settled in its cities?
verses.textZh: 論亞捫人。耶和華如此說：以色列沒有兒子麼？沒有後嗣麼？瑪勒堪為何得迦得之地為業呢？屬他的民為何住其中的城邑呢？

verses.text: 'Therefore behold, the days are coming,' declares the LORD, 'That I will cause a trumpet blast of war to be heard Against Rabbah of the sons of Ammon; And it will become a desolate heap, And her towns will be set on fire. Then Israel will take possession of his possessors,' Says the LORD.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：日子將到，我必使人聽見打仗的喊聲，是攻擊亞捫人拉巴的喊聲。拉巴要成為亂堆；屬他的鄉村（原文是女子）要被火焚燒。先前得以色列地為業的，此時以色列倒要得他們的地為業。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai has been destroyed! Cry out, O daughters of Rabbah, Gird yourselves with sackcloth and lament, And rush back and forth inside the walls; For Malcam will go into exile Together with his priests and his princes.
verses.textZh: 希實本哪，你要哀號，因為愛地變為荒場。拉巴的居民（原文是女子）哪，要呼喊，以麻布束腰；要哭號，在籬笆中跑來跑去；因瑪勒堪和屬他的祭司、首領要一同被擄去。

verses.text: 'How boastful you are about the valleys! Your valley is flowing [away], O backsliding daughter Who trusts in her treasures, [saying], 'Who will come against me?'
verses.textZh: 背道的民（原文是女子）哪，你們為何因有山谷，就是水流的山谷誇張呢？為何倚靠財寶說：誰能來到我們這裡呢？

verses.text: 'Behold, I am going to bring terror upon you,' Declares the Lord GOD of hosts, 'From all [directions] around you; And each of you will be driven out headlong, With no one to gather the fugitives together.
verses.textZh: 主─萬軍之耶和華說：我要使恐嚇從四圍的人中臨到你們；你們必被趕出，各人一直前往，沒有人收聚逃民。

verses.text: 'But afterward I will restore The fortunes of the sons of Ammon,' Declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 後來我還要使被擄的亞捫人歸回。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: Concerning Edom. Thus says the LORD of hosts, 'Is there no longer any wisdom in Teman? Has good counsel been lost to the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?
verses.textZh: 論以東。萬軍之耶和華如此說：提幔中再沒有智慧麼？明哲人不再有謀略麼？他們的智慧盡歸無有麼？

verses.text: 'Flee away, turn back, dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Dedan, For I will bring the disaster of Esau upon him At the time I punish him.
verses.textZh: 底但的居民哪，要轉身逃跑，住在深密處；因為我向以掃追討的時候，必使災殃臨到他。

verses.text: 'If grape gatherers came to you, Would they not leave gleanings? If thieves [came] by night, They would destroy [only] until they had enough.
verses.textZh: 摘葡萄的若來到他那裡，豈不剩下些葡萄呢？盜賊若夜間而來，豈不毀壞直到夠了呢？

verses.text: 'But I have stripped Esau bare, I have uncovered his hiding places So that he will not be able to conceal himself; His offspring has been destroyed along with his relatives And his neighbors, and he is no more.
verses.textZh: 我卻使以掃赤露，顯出他的隱密處；他不能自藏。他的後裔、弟兄、鄰舍盡都滅絕；他也歸於無有。

verses.text: 'Leave your orphans behind, I will keep [them] alive; And let your widows trust in Me.'
verses.textZh: 你撇下孤兒，我必保全他們的命；你的寡婦可以倚靠我。

verses.text: For thus says the LORD, 'Behold, those who were not sentenced to drink the cup will certainly drink [it], and are you the one who will be completely acquitted? You will not be acquitted, but you will certainly drink [it].
verses.textZh: 耶和華如此說：原不該喝那杯的一定要喝。你能盡免刑罰麼？你必不能免，一定要喝！

verses.text: 'For I have sworn by Myself,' declares the LORD, 'that Bozrah will become an object of horror, a reproach, a ruin and a curse; and all its cities will become perpetual ruins.'
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：我指著自己起誓，波斯拉必令人驚駭、羞辱、咒詛，並且荒涼。他的一切城邑必變為永遠的荒場。

verses.text: I have heard a message from the LORD, And an envoy is sent among the nations, [saying], 'Gather yourselves together and come against her, And rise up for battle!'
verses.textZh: 我從耶和華那裡聽見信息，並有使者被差往列國去，說：你們聚集來攻擊以東，要起來爭戰。

verses.text: 'For behold, I have made you small among the nations, Despised among men.
verses.textZh: 我使你在列國中為最小，在世人中被藐視。

verses.text: 'As for the terror of you, The arrogance of your heart has deceived you, O you who live in the clefts of the rock, Who occupy the height of the hill. Though you make your nest as high as an eagle's, I will bring you down from there,' declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 住在山穴中據守山頂的啊，論到你的威嚇，你因心中的狂傲自欺；你雖如大鷹高高搭窩，我卻從那裡拉下你來。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'Edom will become an object of horror; everyone who passes by it will be horrified and will hiss at all its wounds.
verses.textZh: 以東必令人驚駭；凡經過的人就受驚駭，又因他一切的災禍嗤笑。

verses.text: 'Like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah with its neighbors,' says the LORD, 'no one will live there, nor will a son of man reside in it.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：必無人住在那裡，也無人在其中寄居，要像所多瑪、蛾摩拉，和鄰近的城邑傾覆的時候一樣。

verses.text: 'Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan against a perennially watered pasture; for in an instant I will make him run away from it, and whoever is chosen I shall appoint over it. For who is like Me, and who will summon Me [into court]? And who then is the shepherd who can stand against Me?'
verses.textZh: 仇敵必像獅子從約但河邊的叢林上來，攻擊堅固的居所。轉眼之間，我要使以東人逃跑，離開這地。誰蒙揀選，我就派誰治理這地。誰能比我呢？誰能給我定規日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？

verses.text: Therefore hear the plan of the LORD which He has planned against Edom, and His purposes which He has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: surely they will drag them off, [even] the little ones of the flock; surely He will make their pasture desolate because of them.
verses.textZh: 你們要聽耶和華攻擊以東所說的謀略和他攻擊提幔居民所定的旨意。仇敵定要將他們群眾微弱的拉去，定要使他們的居所荒涼。

verses.text: The earth has quaked at the noise of their downfall. There is an outcry! The noise of it has been heard at the Red Sea.
verses.textZh: 因他們仆倒的聲音，地就震動。人在紅海那裡必聽見呼喊的聲音。

verses.text: Behold, He will mount up and swoop like an eagle and spread out His wings against Bozrah; and the hearts of the mighty men of Edom in that day will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.textZh: 仇敵必如大鷹飛起，展開翅膀攻擊波斯拉。到那日，以東的勇士心中疼痛如臨產的婦人。

verses.text: Concerning Damascus. 'Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, For they have heard bad news; They are disheartened. There is anxiety by the sea, It cannot be calmed.
verses.textZh: 論大馬色。哈馬和亞珥拔蒙羞，因他們聽見凶惡的信息就消化了。海上有憂愁，不得平靜。

verses.text: 'Damascus has become helpless; She has turned away to flee, And panic has gripped her; Distress and pangs have taken hold of her Like a woman in childbirth.
verses.textZh: 大馬色發軟，轉身逃跑。戰兢將他捉住；痛苦憂愁將他抓住，如產難的婦人一樣。

verses.text: 'How the city of praise has not been deserted, The town of My joy!
verses.textZh: 我所喜樂可稱讚的城，為何被撇棄了呢？

verses.text: 'Therefore, her young men will fall in her streets, And all the men of war will be silenced in that day,' declares the LORD of hosts.
verses.textZh: 他的少年人必仆倒在街上；當那日，一切兵丁必默默無聲。這是萬軍之耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'I will set fire to the wall of Damascus, And it will devour the fortified towers of Ben-hadad.'
verses.textZh: 我必在大馬色城中使火著起，燒滅便哈達的宮殿。

verses.text: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated. Thus says the LORD, 'Arise, go up to Kedar And devastate the men of the east.
verses.textZh: 論巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒所攻打的基達和夏瑣的諸國。耶和華如此說：迦勒底人哪，起來上基達去，毀滅東方人。

verses.text: 'They will take away their tents and their flocks; They will carry off for themselves Their tent curtains, all their goods and their camels, And they will call out to one another, 'Terror on every side!'
verses.textZh: 他們的帳棚和羊群都要奪去，將幔子和一切器皿，並駱駝為自己掠去。人向他們喊著說：四圍都有驚嚇。

verses.text: 'Run away, flee! Dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Hazor,' declares the LORD; 'For Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has formed a plan against you And devised a scheme against you.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：夏瑣的居民哪，要逃奔遠方，住在深密處；因為巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒設計謀害你們，起意攻擊你們。

verses.text: 'Arise, go up against a nation which is at ease, Which lives securely,' declares the LORD. 'It has no gates or bars; They dwell alone.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：迦勒底人哪，起來！上安逸無慮的居民那裡去；他們是無門無閂、獨自居住的。

verses.text: 'Their camels will become plunder, And their many cattle for booty, And I will scatter to all the winds those who cut the corners [of their hair]; And I will bring their disaster from every side,' declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 他們的駱駝必成為掠物；他們眾多的牲畜必成為擄物。我必將剃周圍頭髮的人分散四方（原文是風），使災殃從四圍臨到他們。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, A desolation forever; No one will live there, Nor will a son of man reside in it.'
verses.textZh: 夏瑣必成為野狗的住處，永遠淒涼；必無人住在那裡，也無人在其中寄居。

verses.text: That which came as the word of the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying:
verses.textZh: 猶大王西底家登基的時候，耶和華論以攔的話臨到先知耶利米說：

verses.text: 'Thus says the LORD of hosts, 'Behold, I am going to break the bow of Elam, The finest of their might.
verses.textZh: 萬軍之耶和華如此說：我必折斷以攔人的弓，就是他們為首的權力。

verses.text: 'I will bring upon Elam the four winds From the four ends of heaven, And will scatter them to all these winds; And there will be no nation To which the outcasts of Elam will not go.
verses.textZh: 我要使四風從天的四方颳來，臨到以攔人，將他們分散四方（原文是風）。這被趕散的人沒有一國不到的。

verses.text: 'So I will shatter Elam before their enemies And before those who seek their lives; And I will bring calamity upon them, Even My fierce anger,' declares the LORD, 'And I will send out the sword after them Until I have consumed them.
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：我必使以攔人在仇敵和尋索其命的人面前驚惶；我也必使災禍，就是我的烈怒臨到他們，又必使刀劍追殺他們，直到將他們滅盡。

verses.text: 'Then I will set My throne in Elam And destroy out of it king and princes,' Declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 我要在以攔設立我的寶座，從那裡除滅君王和首領。這是耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'But it will come about in the last days That I will restore the fortunes of Elam,'' Declares the LORD.
verses.textZh: 到末後，我還要使被擄的以攔人歸回。這是耶和華說的。
